def transform(grid):
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    sep_rows=[i for i,row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row))==1]
    sep_cols=[j for j in range(w) if len({grid[i][j] for i in range(h)})==1]
    # Remove any uniform lines that are merely the background; separators are the
    # uniform lines between equally-sized regions, identified by repeated spacing.
    def segments(n, cuts):
        bounds=[-1]+cuts+[n]
        return [(bounds[k]+1,bounds[k+1]) for k in range(len(bounds)-1)]
    row_segs=segments(h,sep_rows); col_segs=segments(w,sep_cols)
    # Background is the most common color outside uniform separator rows/columns.
    excluded=set(sep_rows),set(sep_cols)
    from collections import Counter
    cnt=Counter(grid[i][j] for i in range(h) for j in range(w) if i not in excluded[0] and j not in excluded[1])
    bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    tiles=[]
    for ri,(r0,r1) in enumerate(row_segs):
        for ci,(c0,c1) in enumerate(col_segs):
            cells=[grid[i][j] for i in range(r0,r1) for j in range(c0,c1)]
            score=sum(v!=bg for v in cells)
            tiles.append((score,ri,ci,r0,r1,c0,c1))
    _,sri,sci,sr0,sr1,sc0,sc1=max(tiles)
    source=[row[sc0:sc1] for row in grid[sr0:sr1]]
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    for ri,(r0,r1) in enumerate(row_segs):
        for ci,(c0,c1) in enumerate(col_segs):
            if (ri,ci)==(sri,sci): continue
            for a,i in enumerate(range(r0,r1)):
                for b,j in enumerate(range(c0,c1)):
                    out[i][j]=source[a][b]
    return out

path=os.path.join(programs,'task-56d16495.py')
source='''from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    background = Counter(value for row in grid for value in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    separator_rows = [i for i, row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row)) == 1 and row[0] != background]
    separator_cols = [j for j in range(w) if len({grid[i][j] for i in range(h)}) == 1 and grid[0][j] != background]

    def segments(size, separators):
        bounds = [-1] + separators + [size]
        return [(bounds[k] + 1, bounds[k + 1]) for k in range(len(bounds) - 1)]

    row_segments = segments(h, separator_rows)
    col_segments = segments(w, separator_cols)
    tiles = []
    for ri, (r0, r1) in enumerate(row_segments):
        for ci, (c0, c1) in enumerate(col_segments):
            count = sum(grid[i][j] != background for i in range(r0, r1) for j in range(c0, c1))
            tiles.append((count, ri, ci, r0, r1, c0, c1))

    _, source_ri, source_ci, r0, r1, c0, c1 = max(tiles)
    source = [row[c0:c1] for row in grid[r0:r1]]
    output = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for ri, (top, bottom) in enumerate(row_segments):
        for ci, (left, right) in enumerate(col_segments):
            if (ri, ci) == (source_ri, source_ci):
                continue
            for a, i in enumerate(range(top, bottom)):
                for b, j in enumerate(range(left, right)):
                    output[i][j] = source[a][b]
    return output
'''
with open(path,'w') as f: f.write(source)
print(path,transform(test)==out,transform(demo)==expected)
